note: Former Port Huron Township RV Park, sold by the township in 2022 and since rebuilt as Dancing Fire Glamping & RV Resort (PH RV Resort LLC): 25 acres on a hillside over Stocks Creek at 2301 Water Street, across the street from the Black River, minutes from I-94/I-69 and the Blue Water Bridge to Canada. Seasonal and overnight RV sites beside glamping units (safari tents, cabins, Airstreams, buses). --Claude
summary: The township RV park is now privately owned and run as Dancing Fire Glamping & RV Resort (same pin: Campspot 42.991851,-82.45675). From the operator's site, 2027 and 2026 rate sheets and Campspot listing: fees changed 29/37 (2022 township sheet) -> 64/89 (2027) plus a mandatory $6.99/night resort fee and $5 booking fee; 140 full-hookup 30/50-amp sites, pull-throughs, showers, laundry, wifi, store (new); reservable on Campspot (new), holiday 2-night minimum. Campspot returned no availability for June/July 2027 dates yet. Season year_round (derived) left: the site states no operating season (it is 'Accepting Winter 2026-2027 and Summer 2027 Seasonal Reservations'). Note rewritten for the new operator.
flags: Ownership/name/website changed: the township sold the park (purchase agreement reported January 2022, Modern Campground) and it reopened as 'Dancing Fire Glamping & RV Resort' (PH RV Resort LLC dba Dancing Fire Glamping and RV Resort; WGRT 2025-08-06: 'The old Port Huron Township Campground is now Dancing Fire Glamping & RV Resort'). Ownership should be private, not local; name 'Dancing Fire Glamping & RV Resort'; website https://dancingfireresort.com/ (the stored 2022 township rate PDF is stale); the township's parks page no longer lists an RV park.

Price gate: as a private park it is over US$50. Cheapest RV site $64 (30-amp full hookup, 2027 and 2026) plus the mandatory $6.99/night All-Inclusive Resort Fee = $70.99 a night before tax. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Detroit 88 km); the family has not stayed here.

Long-stay character: heavy seasonal side (4-6 month contracts, 1-3 month rates, 'Accepting Winter 2026-2027 and Summer 2027 Seasonal Reservations'), but nightly rates are posted for every RV site class and overnight sites book on Campspot, so tests 2 and 4 pass on the pages read.
